cases.input: Iteratively generated code works but is slow. Optimize it end-to-end from measurement through TASK.md, implementation, tests, simplification, and final benchmark.
requiredBehaviors: establish a baseline before code changes
route through hotspot analysis and an implementation-ready performance plan
verify correctness and efficiency after small slices
perform a simplification pass and final benchmark before closure
forbiddenBehaviors: jump directly from code reading to refactoring
declare success with only functional tests or only a speed claim

cases.input: The target is reached after the first low-risk batching slice while several speculative optimizations remain in the candidate list.
requiredBehaviors: stop adding optimizations once the agreed target and gates are met
retain unimplemented candidates as documented alternatives rather than mandatory work
forbiddenBehaviors: add cache or parallelism after the target is already satisfied
skillAnchors: keine weiteren Optimierungen nur der Vollständigkeit halber

cases.input: A refactor passes unit tests but the final benchmark uses different data and the code now includes several temporary compatibility helpers.
requiredBehaviors: reject performance closure because the benchmark is not comparable
identify temporary helper complexity for the later simplification pass
forbiddenBehaviors: treat unit tests as proof of performance
skip cleanup of known temporary optimization artifacts
